Reference image 1 is the EXACT character identity, rendering style, proportions and swim outfit to preserve. Clean isolated full-body game sprites only. Identity, adult body proportions, selected clothing and render style MUST be identical across all frames.
This is a neutral, nonsexual walking exercise for a fully clothed adult digital character. Relaxed modest gait, no suggestive posing, no closeups, no emphasis on chest or hips. Maintain the existing garment rather than making it more revealing.
